eligibility.evidence: Sections 3-6, App. C-E. Pretrained unidirectional LMs (GPT, GPT-2 four sizes, Transformer-XL) are scored on come/go cloze items, with a preregistered Prolific human study (Sec. 4) and behavioural accuracy (Tables 8-9). Borderline: the headline model is a masked LM (RoBERTa), and the task is a new probe motivated by psycholinguistic perspective-taking work (Harris 2012; Brown-Schmidt and Heller 2018) rather than a named classic paradigm.

E.headline: RoBERTa, a bidirectional masked model, matches humans; GPT and GPT-2 do well on automatic items but struggle on annotated ones; humans and RoBERTa show opposite genre-frequency patterns.

G.notes: Only unidirectional LMs enter B; BERT-family models, the paper's main comparison, are masked LMs and excluded. Humans did a bidirectional cloze, models a probability comparison, so accuracies are not strictly comparable. The NN Confounding subset was chosen from model errors. Regressions cover humans and RoBERTa only, with no tests on the generative models.
